description: This PHP class, CandidateVacancyDecorator, functions as a decorator for the CandidateVacancy entity, providing methods to assign vacancy and candidate entities by ID, and to retrieve the status of a candidate vacancy with mapping to readable labels.

classes.name: CandidateVacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateVacancy entity providing methods to set candidate/vacancy by ID and retrieve vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes CandidateVacancyDecorator with a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with the CandidateVacancy by its ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the CandidateVacancy by its ID.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the candidate vacancy, mapped to an ID and label.
